title: A service mapped CI differs from EPO
cardHint: Service mapped CIs whose status, name, people or description differ from EPO. SACM copies the EPO value into ServiceNow.
cardText: Service mapped CIs whose status, name, people or description in ServiceNow are not the same as in EPO (procedure 2.7). The description is compared by letters and digits only: empty in ServiceNow, cut short, or another start. The sync to these CIs is cut, so SACM copies the EPO value into ServiceNow by hand: use the fix list. When the Service Instance changes, change its Business Application too (the card "Application ≠ Instance" shows it at the next report). Never remove the relationships.
